summary: Woori Financial Group filed a 6-K reporting a board resolution to enter into a trust agreement to acquire treasury shares worth KRW 150 billion (~$115M) from July 24, 2026 to January 22, 2027. The purpose is to enhance shareholder return and improve corporate value. Korea Investment Securities Co. is the appointed broker. As of the resolution date, the company held 53,945 treasury shares (0.01%). The filing details the legal limit on treasury share acquisitions based on Korean Commercial Code profit availability. This is a non-US filing equivalent to an issuer tender offer or share buyback program. Watch for execution pace and impact on EPS and shareholder value.
